Tool: built-in image_gen.imagegen. Transparent background: true.
Input: the extracted PSD layer containing the adult stag and fawn.

Use case: identity-preserve. Make a production 2D pixel-art animation sprite sheet for Unity, using ONLY THE LARGE ADULT STAG WITH ANTLERS at the LEFT of the provided PSD layer as the character reference. Exclude the fawn. Preserve this specific deer: warm burnt orange brown fur, white spots on upper back, cream underbelly and muzzle, dark hooves, black pixel outline, branched golden brown antlers, large dark eye with white sparkle. Match its chunky pixel art, no painterly rendering. OUTPUT: square 2048 by 2048 transparent PNG, exactly FOUR equal columns by FOUR equal rows, 16 isolated full-body frames, one stag in each cell, no cell lines, text, labels, numbers, ground, water, props, shadows or background. Critical for animation: ALL frames same character scale, consistent torso size, same left-facing side-view body with same camera, identical placement of torso horizontally within every cell, planted hooves at same ground baseline for stationary frames. Generous clear padding in every cell for antlers and legs, no crossing boundaries. Body size must allow full standing head and full antlers within each cell; reserve top half for raised head even in drinking frames. ROW 1: FOUR sequential drinking poses, head down to left matching reference, tiny muzzle sip movement, subtle ear movement, hooves fixed. ROW 2: FOUR sequential looking-around poses with body standing still in same left-facing side view: 1 head raised and looking left; 2 head turned toward viewer slightly; 3 head turned back over shoulder; 4 head snaps up alert looking left with raised ears. ROWS 3 and 4: EIGHT successive frames of a single continuous anatomically coherent RUN/GALLOP cycle to the LEFT, read left to right row3 then row4. Real deer gallop with distinct leg configurations: extended forelegs and trailing hindlegs, front contact, weight compression, hindlegs gathering under belly, hind push-off, airborne tucked, airborne stretched, forelegs reach for next contact. All four legs carefully drawn in every frame with near/far shading, no extra legs. Keep torso size constant, body centered horizontally, small natural body rise and fall only. Keep antler branch pattern and spots as consistent as possible across all 16 frames. Transparent background with real alpha. No fawn, no birds. This is actual frame animation art, prioritize consistency over detail.

Actual returned image: 1254 x 1254 pixels, RGBA. The generated sheet was not a perfectly regular grid. Disconnected sprites were extracted individually, translated to common 384 x 384 canvases, and aligned by torso/hip and ground reference. Colors, alpha, and body proportions were not rescaled during this packaging step. See the preview GIF for the actual result.
